findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: The handwashing sink in the back room was observed to have a container of graffiti remover in it. CORRECTED- The inspector removed the graffiti remover from the sink basin and educated the PIC that handwashing sinks should always be maintained accessible at all times for employee use. Ensure that handwashing sinks are maintained to be accessible at all times and are only used for their intended purpose of handwashing.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: The handwashing sink in the back room was observed to not have any paper towels at it. CORRECTED- An employee placed paper towels at the handwashing sink and the PIC was educated that all handwashing sinks should always have paper towels at them. Paper towels are necessary to allow for proper handwashing and the use of a barrier when turning off the faucet.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels.

findings.title: Food obtained from approved source.
findings.comment: The facility is observed to be selling hot dogs and tornadoes on roller grills during today’s inspection. The facility does not have a grease trap and the current one is concreted in. A new grease trap would need to be put in and the facility would need to be moved to a Medium Risk to allow these roller grill items to be served in the facility. CORRECTED- The PIC stated that they will cease selling the hot dogs and they were all discarded during today’s inspection. A spot check will be conducted in the future to ensure that the equipment has been removed from the facility and that these roller grill items are no longer being sold.
findings.citation_text: 3-201.11(A) Compliance with Food Law. (A) FOOD shall be obtained from sources that comply with LAW.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The top of the inside of the Bunn coffee machine is observed to have an accumulation of soil residue on it. A follow up is scheduled on 11/3/2025 to ensure that the top of the inside of the Bunn coffee machine has been cleaned. Ensure that food contact surfaces are frequently cleaned and are clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT- There were pre-packaged sandwiches that were observed to be in the cooler that did not bear any date-marking on them. This was discussed with the PIC. The PIC stated that the sandwiches arrive frozen and that they are placed into the cooler upon arrival. The PIC stated that these items were placed in the cooler on Tuesday. It was discussed with the PIC that these must be date-marked when put out and discarded if not sold within 7 days. CORRECTED- The sandwiches were date-marked during the inspection.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.17(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Date Marking. (A) Except when PACKAGING FOOD using a REDUCED OXYGEN PACKAGING method as specified under § 3-502.12, and except as specified in (E) and (F) of this section, refrigerated, READY-TO-EAT, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD prepared and held in a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date or day by which the FOOD shall be consumed on the PREMISES, sold, or discarded when held at a temperature of 5C (41F) or less for a maximum of 7 days. The day of preparation shall be counted as Day 1.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored and used.
findings.comment: There were bottles of a bleach cleaning spray observed to be above boxes of cereal. CORRECTED- These boxes of cereal were moved to another shelf, where they were not exposed to contamination. Ensure that chemicals are never stored above food items. Food items should be protected from contamination during storage and display.
findings.citation_text: 7-201.11 Separation. Poisonous or toxic materials shall be stored so they can not contaminate food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single-service and single-use articles by: (A) Separating the POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS by spacing or partitioning; and (B) Locating the POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS in an area that is not above FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE or SINGLE-USE ARTICLES.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored and used.
findings.comment: The bleach that the facility is observed to be using for food-contact surfaces does not have an EPA Registration Number. A follow up is scheduled for 10/27/2025 to ensure that the facility has obtained an EPA-Registered Bleach. This was discussed with the PIC.
findings.citation_text: 7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria. Chemical SANITIZERS, including chemical sanitizing solutions generated on-site, and other chemical antimicrobials applied to FOOD-CONTACT SURFACEs shall: (A) Meet the requirements specified in 40 CFR 180.940 Tolerance exemptions for active and inert ingredients for use in antimicrobial formulations (Food-contact surface sanitizing solutions), or (B) Meet the requirements as specified in 40 CFR 180.2020 Pesticide Chemicals Not Requiring a Tolerance or Exemption from Tolerance-Nonfood determinations.

findings.title: Single use/single service articles are properly stored and used.
findings.comment: There were single-service forks and knives that were observed to be in cups with their food-contact surface being exposed to contamination. CORRECTED- The utensils were inverted by an employee and the PIC was educated that these should be displayed inverted to protect them from contamination. Ensure that single service articles and utensils are handled, displayed, and dispensed to protect the food-contact surface from contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-904.11(A) Kitchenware and Tableware. (A) SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of FOOD- and lip-contact surfaces is prevented.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: The facility is observed to be using bleach as a sanitizer, but did not have any Chlorine test strips. This was discussed with the PIC. A follow up is scheduled on 11/3/2025 to ensure that Chlorine test strips have been obtained.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following nonfood contact surfaces are observed to be in need of cleaning: 

1. The walk-in cooler fan covers are observed to have an accumulation of dust on them. 
2. The shelf the microwave is on is observed to have an accumulation of soil residue on it. 

Ensure that nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained cleaned.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Ice machine was observed to contain an accumulation of mold on the back baffle.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure ice machine is cleaned regularly to prevent contamination of ice.

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Pre-packaged sandwiches were observed to be stocked in the cooler without a use-by or expiration date.  Discussed with PIC, sandwiched were discarded.  Ensure all pre-packaged foods are date marked according to the bulk package it arrives in.

3-501.18: (A) FOOD shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time criteria. If container or PACKAGE does not bear a date or day or if inappropriately marked with date or day exceeding temperature and time combination. (B) Refrigerated RTE TCS FOOD prepared in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and dispensed through vending machine shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment: A CFM will need to be present during all hours of operation. Discussed with Jennifer that she needs to at least be enrolled in the class prior to allowing to upgrade.
